paite: Himahleh naute aw, ahun leh ani lam thute himhim gelhsak na kiphamoh kei uh.
heading: Toupa Ni
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

paite: Toupa ni tuh zan lai in guta bang in ahong tung ding chih noumau ngei in chiantak in na thei uhi.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

paite: Muanna leh bitna chi a agen laitak un numei nauvei bang in thakhat in manthatna atung uah atung ding a, asuakta kei hial ding uhi.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, nou zaw huai ni in guta bang a hon bingphawn ding in mial ah na om kei uhi.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

paite: Vak tate leh sun tate na hi vek ngal ua; zan a mi i hi kei ua, mial a mi leng i hi sam kei uhi.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

paite: Huaiziak in midangte bang in i ihmu kei ding uh, hak ni in limsak zaw ni.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

paite: Ihmute zan in ahi a-ihmut uh; zukhamte leng zan in ahi akham uh.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

paite: Himahleh eite bel sun a mi i hih ziak in, ginna leh itna lum tawi in, hotdam lametna lukhu a zang in limsak zaw ni.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

paite: Pathian in thangpaihna thuak ding hilou in, Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a hotdamna mu ding zaw in ahon chi hi.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: I hah in leng i ihmut in leng, amah toh i hinkhawm theihna ding in i sih sik in amah asita hi.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

paite: Huaiziak in kihanthawntuah chiat in, na hih zel mah bang un kitungdingtuah chiat un.
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

paite: Huan unaute aw, na lak ua semgim leh Toupa a na heutu ua na omleh nou hon thuhilhte thei ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
heading: Kithuhilhna
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

paite: Anasep ziak un it in ngai thupi mahmah un. Noumau kituak in om un.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

paite: Tu in unaute aw, ka hon hanthawn uhi, dan lou a omte hilh unla, lungkete hanthawn un, hatloute panpih unla, mi tengteng lak ah thuakzoutak in om un.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

paite: Kuamah in kua gitlouh leng gilou a thuk lou ding in pilvang un; thil na kihihsaktuahna lam uah leh mi tengteng tung a na hihsakna lam uah leng ahoih lamlam zui un.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

paite: Nuam gige un;
english: Always rejoice.

paite: tawp lou in thum un;
english: Pray without ceasing.

paite: bangkim ah kipahthu gen gige un; huai tuh noumau lam a Khrist Jesu ah Pathian deihlam ahi.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

paite: Kha phelh kei un;
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

paite: thugente simmoh kei un;
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

paite: bangkim enchian zaw unla, ahoih lam peuhmah len tinten un;
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

paite: gilou lam peuhmah ah kihemkhia un.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

paite: Huchi in lemna Pathian ngei in nou hon hihsiangthou sipsip hen; na kha uh leh na lungsim uh leh na pumpi uh i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong pai chiang in gensiatbei in humbit in omsuak sipsip hen.
heading: Vualzawlna
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Nou hon sampa amuanhuai a, hih leng ahih ding hi.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

paite: Unaute aw, hon thumsak un.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

paite: Unaute tengteng tawp siangthou in chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

paite: Hiai laithon unau tengteng kiang ah sim ngeingei ding in Toupa min in ka hon ngen hi.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
